note: League of Legends, Vietnamese accounts. From upstream GamePingBooster captures (2026-09-18 and 2026-09-22, Hanoi, six sessions): every match went to 151.106.247.7 on UDP 7331, about 54 packets/s. 151.106.247.0/24 is announced by AS6507 exactly, so only that /24 is routed. The server answers no ICMP or TCP, so there is no landmark - compare ping in game with the tunnel on and off.

regions.name: Việt Nam
regions.note: Server trận đấu 151.106.247.7 (UDP 7331) đặt tại Việt Nam. Relay VN-1 cách server khoảng 2,5 ms; relay Singapore đi vòng qua Hong Kong nên chậm hơn nhiều.
